A fence, electric (time lapse to music)

A time lapse of my electric fence installation. My neighbor replaced our sturdy, but old, wooden fence with a plastic decorative fence. She then began complaining when her dog and mine would go anywhere near it. After recently being awoken to more complaints at 5 AM, I decided to install my own fence to keep my dogs away.

The fence zaps anything touching it once every few seconds. It feels like a static electricity discharge. It doesn't hurt much but you don't want to hold on to it. Of course, I tested my fence on myself.

"Bumble" by Podington Bear is available from freemusicarchive.org.

Edit: Total cost: ~$100, with left over insulators and poly-wire.
